name: Paint-Ready Slat Fluted Panels
summary: Primed white MDF with the Slat profile routed into the face and about five coats of primer sanded flat. A PVC film is bonded to the back for rigidity.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: Slat has 1.11 in flat faces, 0.55 in square channels, 1.66 in pitch, 7 repeats per panel, 0.14 in cut depth and 0.20 in total thickness; its stated 11.80 in panel width differs from 7 pitches (11.62 in), so this seamless tile preserves the exact pitch over seven repeats. Main-photo neutral primed white is exposure-corrected for unlit albedo across faces and groove floors, with subtle sanded-primer texture, no exposed wood grain or felt; the 11.62 by 23.24 in tile has no vertical board joints.
